content.what_it_is: MATLAB extraction script (NTHMP BP1 solitary wave on plane beach, spherical run) producing gauge time series aligned to the analytical solution. Loads analytical_RU.mat (L3; provides t2, y2 analytical runup series) and model stations sta_0001 (d2) and sta_0002 (d1) (L5-6). dep=100 m, a=1.9 (L8-9, a unused). Non-dimensionalizes d1 time by sqrt(9.81/dep) (L12-14). Finds the model runup peak time tmax1 (argmax of d1(:,2), L16-25) and the analytical peak time tmax2 (argmax of y2, L27-37); gap=tmax1-tmax2 (L38). Builds output rows only where time strictly increases (L42-43): column 1 shifted non-dimensional time d1(:,1)-gap, column 2 d2(:,2)/dep, column 3 d1(:,2)/dep with values below -0.0145 set to NaN (L45-50). Writes tab-delimited FUNWAVE_BP1_GAUGE.txt, precision 6 (L54).
entities: script variables: fdir @L2, d2 @L5, d1 @L6, dep @L8, a @L9, n @L10, kk @L16, ll @L17, tmax1 @L25, n2 @L27, kk2 @L28, ll2 @L29, tmax2 @L37, gap @L38, ii @L41, data @L45-49; t2,y2 from analytical_RU.mat @L3

equations.ref: clip below -0.0145 to NaN (dry gauge floor)

calls: clear all @L1; load @L3, @L5, @L6; length @L10, @L27; sqrt @L13; dlmwrite @L54
unresolved: d2's time column is never rescaled or used (only d1's, L12-14); d2(:,2) is sampled at the same row index i (L46), assuming both stations share identical sampling.
The -0.0145 NaN floor (L48) presumably masks the dry-gauge minimum at station 2; the constant's origin is not stated; a=1.9 (L9) is unused.

The i-filter d1(i,1)>d1(i-1,1) (L43) drops rows where time did not increase -- suggests the station file may contain repeated time stamps (restart overlap); cause external to this file; station-to-gauge mapping (sta_0002 = runup/shoreline gauge) is implicit.
